verdicts.reason: Both candidates are the same broken layout. The checkmarks are cut off from their list items, which have shrunk to tiny, unreadable text in the bottom-right corner. The $50 sits apart beside a stray vertical rule, and 'ONE DAY ONLY TO SAVE' has fallen below the photo and the URL, so the reading order is scrambled. The photo is shrunk and off-centre, and torn tape pieces float around without the note card they used to hold down. The only difference is the shape of the bottom-left tape piece, which doesn't matter.
